lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiZn2Fe4O8 (Li2Zn4Fe8O16) crystallizes in orthorhombic symmetry with space group Immm (No. 15). Its unit cell contains 30 atoms across seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and Zn centers each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Li centers have eight O neighbors and O centers adopt tetrahedral or five-vertex environments, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 1.83–2.33 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between O tetrahedra and corner-sharing between O tetrahedra and five-vertex O polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
